name: smwgraphics-deku-baba
title: Deku Baba
description:
A reskin of the piranha plant family to the iconic Deku Baba plants from The Legend of Zelda. These plants are very angry and they want a piece of careless players. A great fit for forest, jungle and Zelda themed levels. Includes a fix which remaps the palette and graphics of the stem, which I got from the VLDC13 baserom, so thanks to AmperSam, as well.

Credit should go to No Body The Dragon.
